node.title: Re^3: Trying to grep array of hashes
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [Athanasius],

You're absolutely right of course. My intention was to warn that, if only exact matches are desired, "ABC DEF GHI"=~/\bDEF\b/ ("DEF" being a "[doc://substr]ing" of "ABC DEF GHI") would give a false positive. But by omitting a discussion of \b, my node became inaccurate, so thank you for the reply :-)

Thanks,
-- Hauke D
